## Load data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)

intakes_old <- read_csv("data/Intakes_2013_to_2025.csv") |> clean_names()
intakes_new <- read_csv("data/Intakes_20261114.csv") |> clean_names()
outcomes_old <- read_csv("data/Outcomes_2013_to_2025.csv") |> clean_names()
outcomes_new <- read_csv("data/Outcomes_20261114.csv") |> clean_names()

glimpse(intakes_old)
glimpse(outcomes_old)
glimpse(intakes_new)
glimpse(outcomes_new)
```

## Prepare dates

```{r}
to_date <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, c("Date", "POSIXt"))) {
    as_date(x)
  } else {
    as_date(parse_date_time(x, orders = c("YbdIMSp",
                                          "YmdHMS",
                                          "Ymd",
                                          "mdYIMSp")))
  }
}

intakes_old <- intakes_old |>
  mutate(intake_id = row_number(),
         intake_date = to_date(date_time))

outcomes_old_clean <- outcomes_old |>
  transmute(animal_id,
            outcome_date = to_date(date_time),
            outcome_type)

sum(is.na(intakes_old$intake_date))
sum(is.na(outcomes_old_clean$outcome_date))
range(intakes_old$intake_date)

intakes_old |> count(year = year(intake_date))
```

## Prepare outcomes

```{r}
outcomes_all <- outcomes_old_clean |>
  mutate(outcome_type = str_to_lower(outcome_type)) |>
  distinct()

outcomes_all |> count(outcome_type, sort = TRUE)

# Confirm where each old file ends
max(intakes_old$intake_date)
max(outcomes_all$outcome_date)
```
